8399341532573463887:
...No Elder was willing to help us. They all said there was no hope, to accept fate and let the child be released. 
A person has only one life. If "released," there will be nothing left. 
A student named Zhang heard of this and said: The twelve Golden Statues in the Mohist Canon can dance and speak. Since limbs can be replaced, why not the head? 
Truly a Mad Man... But if we want to save this one life, we have no choice but to try... and we must do it ourselves. 
The Elders said that merging machinery with flesh is a forbidden art of the Mohist School—that child should not live. I always thought Zhang Wanshi was a gentle man, but it was the first time I saw him so angry. 
Throughout this year, with every growth, the joints felt like being scraped by a dull Blade, unbearable pain. Zhang Wanshi found Anesthesia Powder, but the child was stubborn, preferring to scream rather than sleep. 
...Did we really do a good thing? 
By year's end, we will leave for Mohist Hill. From then on, no one can predict the child's fate. 
Before leaving, Qing asked me, what is the world beyond the mountains really like? What kind of world would deny a child a chance to live? 
I couldn't answer... But we all knew the answer lies beyond the mountains, not in the classrooms of Mohist Hill.
